attributes.board_name: New Mexico Physical Therapy Board (Regulation and Licensing Department)

rules.accepted_credit_types: APTA/NMAPTA-sponsored or APTA-approved programs accepted automatically; other courses meeting Board criteria (licensees may request approval before or after). Live programs (up to 30), college courses (max 30 per 3-credit course), in-services (max 30), home study and internet courses (max 30 each), management courses (max 15), presenting (3x audience hours, max 15), journal reading (0.5 per article, max 15), research (max 30), specialty certificate courses, specialty exams, APTA residency/fellowship and FSBPT continued-competence exams (max 30 each), clinical instruction 1 h per 40 h (max 15), APTA Code of Ethics course, legislative updates at NMAPTA meetings.
rules.new_licensee_rule: No continuing education for the first renewal.
rules.audit_note: Non-audited licensees sign an affidavit and keep documentation for the previous cycle; audited licensees submit proof with the renewal. The Board audits a percentage of renewals each year.
rules.notes: No mandatory topics. Biennial renewal; licenses expire February 1 after no more than two years of licensure (cycle depends on initial licensure date). All 30 hours must be earned in the current 2-year period February 1 - January 31. Late fee $250 (PT) / $200 (PTA).
